summary: All 53 retained files matched their listed sizes and SHA-256 hashes, and all five computed claims reproduced. The evidence supports access_blocked_documented. The paper reports 105 rhythm-disrupted ARC genes, while the registered analysis estimates a genotype effect across four time points. Agreement for that effect remains untested. The corrected proposal clarifies the registry error, pool sizes and limits of the supplement search. It passed the proposal validator.
openIssues: Science Data S1–S8 and both named PMC attachments remained inaccessible on the tested routes. Whether they contain comparable author effects is unknown.
The registry still names Bmal1/Clock and counts individual mice. GEO and the paper identify hepatocyte Nr1d1/Nr1d2 deletion and three ARC pools per arm per time point.
Exact donor membership and pool sizes remain undocumented. The GEO protocols and the manuscript’s general methods also give different housing temperatures.
